commits.title: A scan test keeps the admin's text registry inside the admin, with a ceiling per shopper entry

changes.how: A Vitest scan test, no database. Copy the walking helpers of src/lib/storefront-bundle.scan.test.ts into this file (IMPORT regex, typesOnly(), resolve() without its zod special case, files(), and a reach(entry, planted?) that follows static value imports over src and does NOT stop at "use server" files (drop the `directive(text, "use server")` skip: the seven entries run on the server, where a server action file's code is loaded, unlike the browser bundle that test checks); `planted` is an optional Map<file, extra specifier[]> whose specifiers are treated as extra imports of that file). Case A: list every non-test .ts/.tsx file under src that is not under src/app/admin or src/components/admin and has a value import whose source resolves to src/lib/admin-text.ts; expect []. Case B, one ceiling per entry, each written as a number in a constant object CEILINGS in the test: the entries are src/proxy.ts, src/app/api/visit/route.ts, src/app/api/visit/touch/route.ts, src/app/api/visit/speed/route.ts, src/app/api/visit/speed/own/route.ts, src/app/api/recommendations/events/route.ts and src/app/s/[store]/[market]/layout.tsx. For each, count the reached files under src/lib/admin-messages/. Set each ceiling to the number the walk finds on the day you write the test (expected: 37 for the proxy and the layout; for the five beacons 37 if step 0.4 is not in yet, 2 or 3 if it is). No ceiling may be above 37. Assert count <= ceiling, and also assert count >= ceiling so a fall fails until the number is lowered in the test (the message says 'lower CEILINGS[entry] to <count>'). Case C: none of the seven entries reaches src/lib/admin-text.ts. Case D (would-notice): the reach of src/lib/admin-text.ts itself holds at least 130 files of src/lib/admin-messages. Case E (planted): reach('src/app/api/visit/route.ts', planted = new Map([[<absolute path of src/app/api/visit/route.ts>, ['@/lib/admin-text']]])) counts at least 130 catalogue files (the registry loads every area), so assert that the planted count is greater than CEILINGS['src/app/api/visit/route.ts']. Plant the registry, not an area module: the beacon may already reach staff-emails, and then a planted area module adds nothing. Top comment: 'The admin's words stay out of shoppers' functions (bloat review step 0.7). Ceilings only fall. Step 1.8's route-load.graph.test.ts later forbids src/lib/admin-messages to the proxy and the beacons outright.'

In importers() the pattern near line 49 is /^import (?!type )[^;]*from "@\/lib\/admin-messages\/[\w-]+\.en";/m. Add a second test case (do not change the first): no "use client" module anywhere under src has a value import from "@/lib/admin-words/…" (pattern /^import (?!type )[^;]*from "@\/lib\/admin-words\/[\w-]+";/m); expect []. An area module holds both languages and must never reach a browser. If this new case fails for a file today (a client part that imports src/lib/work-text.ts does not count: the pattern looks at direct imports only), stop and report.

In section 3.3 'The admin', after the bullet '**Catalogue:**', add a bullet: '**Outside the admin:** code that is not under `src/app/admin` or `src/components/admin` (emails, cron jobs, routes, `src/lib`) never imports `src/lib/admin-text.ts`, which loads every area in both languages. It reads its area from `src/lib/admin-words/{stem}.ts` (`STAFF_EMAILS_WORDS[lang]`); a new area read outside the admin gets such a module and its `CATALOGUES` entry becomes that pair. `src/lib/admin-text-reach.scan.test.ts` holds it, with a ceiling of catalogue files for the proxy, the beacons and the storefront layout that only falls (bloat review step 0.7).'

Near line 566 the rule says the admin's words are catalogues per area 'read by `adminText(lang, area)` on the server'. Add after that clause: '(inside the admin; code outside `src/app/admin` and `src/components/admin` reads `src/lib/admin-words/{stem}.ts`, bloat review step 0.7)'.
